title: With Rashawn Slater and Joe Alt back, Chargers open camp in a 'Christmas' mood

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With Rashawn Slater and Joe Alt back, Chargers open camp in a 'Christmas' mood
sources.description: With the offensive line finally healthy and quarterback Justin Herbert working closely with Mike McDaniel, the Chargers open training camp in an upbeat mood.
